title: Smart pet feeder or tracker
summary: Track and feed your pet remotely.
whyItFails: Hardware competition. Cheap alternatives. Reliability. Failures harm pets. Low recurring revenue. Hard to sell subscriptions.
whatWouldChange: Subscription services (food, vet) bundled with hardware.

attempts.outcome: Week-long outage in 2020 left feeders offline
attempts.notes: Customers reported feeders not dispensing food; the company was largely unreachable.

reasons.detail: Low recurring revenue: Hard to sell subscriptions.
